one_liner: Paygent Connect (gopaygent.com) is a payments platform with a REST API, bearer API keys (pgt_live_...), webhooks and a sandbox, plus a free plan. Other unrelated "Paygent" products appear in the evidence, so identity is a risk.
auth_notes: The gopaygent.com curl example sends a static bearer key (pgt_live_...) in the Authorization header. No OAuth is shown.
access_notes: The gopaygent.com homepage says "No credit card required. Free plan available." and lists sandbox testing. The pages do not confirm that the free plan includes API keys.
blocker_notes: The MCP servers in the pages belong to different products. These are api.paygent.tech (virtual cards), withpaygent.com (@paygent-ai/mcp-server, usage billing) and the paygentic-sdk GitHub repo. None of them is gopaygent.com. The gopaygent.com developer docs (https://gopaygent.com/developers/docs) were not fetched, so "none" for MCP is unverified and kept only as the draft value, with low confidence. Whether the free plan includes API keys is also unverified.
